player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndi Player {player_id}. Mukuchita game ya Battleship.
Lengo lanu ndi kumwauka madzi a mdzuka wanu wose kabisa kulowa kumwauka madzi anu.
Pa turn yanu, munaweza kufyetsa mafuta ku coordinates mahususi mu fomu: '[a4]'. Iki mafuta anaukonda ship, inalekezwa na 'X'. Iki sanaukonde, inalekezwa na 'O'. Kuwonjezera, mazingira a game adzakuambisanthula za ukondwesi.
Iki munauka dziko, mazingira a game adzakunena!
Game imakhala ikapitirira kupita madzi a wache awiri.
Board yanu ya kwanju ndi yonse yotsegulidwa, yonse madzi anu akhalekwa, na ukondezi wa mdzuka wanu, na ukondezi wanu na osakondezi kweni board ya mdzuka wanu bila kuwonyeza madzi a mdzuka wanu.
Ikulu ndi board yanu ya kwanju:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wosewerayo sanayankhe ndi makonzedwe olondola m'makona a mabwalo.
